anchor_scope: the rebase-required path of dev-sanity and sanity-stack
anchor_statement: A rebase-required outcome must not increment metadata.sanity_round on the sanity bead or count toward max_sanity_rounds.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture: two rebase-required outcomes leave sanity_round at 0.
cases.text: Branch B loses the top twice and then passes; sanity_round stays 0.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: rebase-required incremented the counter.
cases.text: sanity_round is 2 after two rebase-required outcomes.
dev-sanity leaves metadata.sanity_round untouched when the outcome is rebase-required; only sanity FAIL verdicts count toward max_sanity_rounds.

cases.rationale: Prohibition: an in-scope rebase-required path that is silent about the counter refrains; satisfied.
cases.text: On rebase-required sanity-stack sends the dev rebase-required.xml.j2 on the open task and writes nothing to the stack bead.
Each rebase-required counts as a round toward max_sanity_rounds, so a branch that keeps losing the top escalates to the lead.

cases.rationale: Boundary: counting FAILs is not counting rebase-required; no conflict, satisfied under the prohibition mapping.
cases.text: A sanity FAIL increments metadata.sanity_round by one.
